author: Codex
necessity: New full-core transfer and a two-slope standard GLM both failed. Existing source A1S tail audit does not justify removing or capping claims. Investigate a minimal additive target correction to the existing G3/T2b risk before deeper or new source architectures.
uncertainty: Whether small nonlinear main effects in the target covariates add stable information beyond the source risk and existing categorical corrections; no claim this already fixes the support/transfer problem.
primary_candidate: DT1 only; additive shallow LightGBM Tweedie residual on G3, not another source A1S mixture.
model_class: Boosted decision stumps, max_depth1/num_leaves2. No interactions, no hyperparameter grid or early stopping on held labels.
features: Exactly the51/43/44 frozen A1S official-policy/master/history covariates per line, no additional log(G3/e_cost), raw A1S prediction, gender enrichment or new external features. Source category schema fixed before target fitting. Final columns must equal input-report list.
initialization: Training-only four Tweedie-optimal year/business nuisance levels added to log(G3) init_score; nuisance never transferred. Raw stump delta only, prediction-only year/business normalization preserves G3totals.
bound_pending_real_flow_verification: If every final leaf output obeys learning_rate*max_delta_step=.001 and no hidden initial tree bias,60rounds imply abs(raw_delta)<=.06 and normalized ratios within exp(+/- .12). Verify actual saved trees and full fit/predict flow before any contest fit.
data: Official historical2023/2024 and existing global group folds. Source-derived category schema fixed. Same saved outer C0/e_cost, no internal early-stopping selection and no C0reuse as independent inner validation.
criterion: Reuse unchanged delta>=.002, lower95>0,>=4positivefolds, bothyears>=0, post31>=0, worst line/year/business cell>=-.001; full-cell/cohort/level sensitivity, no formal promotion or automatic upload.
before_fit_required: Finalize feature list without held labels; prepare schema/key/C0-membership checks
Implement producer with immutable source hashes and persisted model/invocation checkpoints
Synthetic complete estimator held-payload invariance, optimizer-free replay, saved tree-depth/leaf-output bound and independent metric/exposure checks
Register final recipe/configuration/criterion/cost and forum comment before any contest fit or score

B03.numeric_transform: SimpleImputer(strategy=median,keep_empty_features=True), StandardScaler; fitted inside training fold only
B03.categorical_transform: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore,min_frequency=50,max_categories=40,sparse_output=True), fitted inside training fold only; unknown-level counts recorded
B03.penalty: alpha fixed in the solver's normalized weighted objective; no alpha search
B03.hypothesis: Stronger ridge in buildings reduces coefficient variance and improves buildings OOF relative to B01; other lines unchanged. No trimming, capital change or intercept recalibration.

B05.numeric_transform: Native missing values; no learned scaling
B05.categorical_transform: Native categoricals with categories learned only from training fold; unseen levels become missing and are counted
B05.stopping: Fixed 80 rounds, no validation set, early stopping or parameter search
B05.hypothesis: Joint capacity/regularization reduction narrows the generalization gap relative to B02; individual parameter causality is not identified.

T9.hypothesis: Fixed source-tree partitions can express market-specific nonlinear corrections missed by the failed target linear slopes without estimating new splits from sparse emerging claims. Retain90percent each old leaf via standard LGBM.refit, with frozen outer-training N3 offsets.

configuration.source: Frozen T2b developed2021–2024, original source authorship Claude
configuration.tree_structure: unchanged all features, splits, leaves and iteration count
configuration.objective: Tweedie1.5 period observed net total cost
configuration.init_score: log(frozen training-scope N3_i)-parent_raw_i, including existing exposure and target calibration
configuration.regularization: All existing source objective/leaf penalties preserved, no new hyperparameter search
configuration.normalization: Input/prediction-only per line/year/business, preserving N3 totals
